Subject: Project Timeline Update: New Date April 14

Third-party certification for the payment integration has taken longer than the vendor originally projected, and that dependency now pushes the overall project timeline by two weeks. The revised delivery date is 14 April, and the team is continuing work on every component that doesn't depend on that certification so the two weeks are the full extent of the impact.

To keep things moving without surprises, we're building in a short buffer after certification clears for final integration testing before handoff. Would 14 April still work with any downstream plans or launch activities on your end?

We'll send a confirmation as soon as the certification comes through, along with a brief status note each week until delivery. In the meantime, please reach out with any questions or scheduling constraints we should factor in.
